A firm, polite note works best here: state the issue, the timeline, the impact, and the action you need by a clear deadline.

## Email Draft for the Leaking Kitchen Ceiling

**Subject:** Urgent: Kitchen Ceiling Leak Requiring Inspection and Repair

Dear [Landlord’s Name],

I’m writing to notify you of a leak in the kitchen ceiling at my unit in Toronto.

The leak began on **2026-02-03** after heavy rain. Since then, there has been **visible water staining** on the ceiling and a **small drip whenever it rains**. I have already informed building management twice by text on **2026-02-04** and **2026-02-06**, but the issue is still ongoing.

Please arrange for an **inspection within 48 hours** and let me know what **temporary repair measures** will be taken to prevent further water damage. I would also appreciate **written confirmation of the next steps**, including the timing for any permanent repair.

Because the leak appears to be weather-related and is affecting the kitchen ceiling, I’d like this addressed promptly to avoid further damage.

Thank you for your quick attention to this matter. Please confirm receipt of this email and the expected inspection time.

Kind regards,
[Your Full Name]
[Your Unit Number]
[Your Phone Number]

## Short Follow-Up Message After 3 Business Days

Hi [Landlord’s Name], I’m following up on my email regarding the kitchen ceiling leak in my unit. Since there has been no reply yet, please confirm by return message when the inspection will take place and what temporary repair steps will be arranged. I’d appreciate written confirmation as soon as possible.
